results.title: Still Here
results.overview: Adrift between memories and an endless void, a young man searches for a way back to something he thought he had lost.

results.title: The Spirit of Halloween
results.overview: Brilliant bridal designer Everly Stone has no patience for Halloween, especially the beloved fire-station bash that once left her heartbroken in front of everyone she knew, but when her late mentor appears with a glamorous warning, Everly Stone is swept through one unforgettable night by three mischievous spirits who reveal the joy she lost, the people she’s pushing away, and the future she might miss if she keeps hiding behind work and fear. With a loyal assistant ready for more, a town waiting to welcome her back, and longtime friend Beau Madison still carrying a spark from their past, Everly Stone must decide whether Halloween is the night that broke her heart or the one that can finally help it heal.

results.title: BAR BOO
results.overview: Through different testimonials from well-known industry figures, such as Enrique López Lavigne, Marta Medina, and Gustavo Salmerón, we delve into the world starring Luis Bar Boo, the man who turned Conan into a barbarian, who was shot dead by Clint Eastwood, who fell from the top of a lighthouse after being pushed by Kirk Douglas, who rode alongside Sean Connery, who challenged Timothy Dalton... and yet, despite all this, nobody knows him.

results.title: Dragon
results.overview: In a stagnant mountain pool, A-Mao fishes for a hidden giant lizard, dragging others into a bloody, infectious madness. Paralyzed and numb, his broken husk crawls back to the murk. At his physical limit, can this eerie desire drive his will to transcend the flesh?

results.title: Beach Fictions
results.overview: On a train, a novelist meets Tae-ju, a young woman who resembles the protagonist of her novel in progress. Tae-ju runs away from damaging rumors to a seaside town. There, she meets Man-hyuk, a street magician, and feels drawn to him—only to hear unsettling rumors about him. Unsure of what to believe, Tae-ju visits a fortune-teller mentioned as being remarkably accurate.

results.title: A Few of Shakespeare's Days of Despair
results.original_title: A Few of Shakespeare's Days of Despair
results.overview: Unable to write for a long time, William Shakespeare embarks on a desperate search for inspiration. But everything he encounters forces him to confront his own legacy and creative burnout.

results.title: Ei Shohorer Gaan
results.overview: Set against the vibrant backdrop of Kolkata, this emotional drama weaves together the lives of dreamers searching for love, purpose, and belonging. As their journeys intersect through art, relationships, and personal struggles, they discover the strength to hold on to hope in a city filled with chaos, heartbreak, and possibility.

results.title: I Came to See
results.overview: In the Forest of Fontainebleau, a filmmaker follows a hunt. As she integrates into the group, she gradually becomes complicit.

results.title: Our Share of Sand
results.overview: After years apart, 12 year-old Maya returns to India with her mother to reunite with her father - a sandmining business man. Immersed in a world where labour, legacy and extraction collide, she forms a fragile bond with Kiran, a young worker. After a tragic event, a police investigation turns Maya into a key witness, with her father relying on her to absolve him. Torn between loyalty and a growing unease she cannot name, Maya begins searching for the truth. As her mother quietly unravels, Maya uncovers a pattern of silence, exploitation and repeated harm forcing her to confront her father's deception and the family's complicity she must choose to break.

results.title: El murmullo del agua
results.overview: During a birthday party, Luca, a sensitive and lonely boy, begins to feel out of place among the other children. As tensions rise, he takes refuge in the fantasy of being a mermaid, imagining a place where he can breathe.

results.title: Salt Electric
results.overview: 1990s Goa, a curious 18-year-old uncovers her brother's hidden VHS stash. What begins as a clandestine screening evolves into a tender, electric awakening of her own unfathomable desires.

results.title: The Form and the Silence
results.overview: Pushed by the precision of a demanding rehearsal, a young actress navigates the quiet tension between who she is and who she feels she needs to be.

results.title: A Three-story House
results.overview: Six-year-old Wenwen pounds on her locked door. Ignored, she cries to Grandma, who threatens her with a slipper. Grandpa arrives, ordering Grandma to cook, and slaps her backtalk. The arcade poodle bolts to the roof while Second Aunt screams curses. Tension fills the entire house.

results.title: Outsiders
results.overview: Davey's Chambers life is forever altered when an alien invasion forces him to survive with strangers inside of his compact flat.

results.title: Infectious
results.overview: Years after a global collapse caused by a strange pandemic, a former healthcare worker testifies in court about an illegal transplant operation that may have triggered the outbreak. What began as an illegal heart transplant ended up releasing a virus capable of turning those infected into violent, cannibalistic creatures.

results.title: FUN
results.overview: A 10-year-old boy encounters two teenage bullies with his pet rabbit on his way home from school. He needs to think of an escape plan while the two teens confront him with sinister games and an impossible choice.

results.title: Throw Away the Lover
results.overview: The only son of an Azerbaijani vampire family brings the girls he is in a relationship with home to meet his family.

results.title: The Iris Protocol
results.overview: For years, Iris believed the surface was unsafe. But when she leaves the safety of her bunker, she unearths a reality far more twisted than she imagined—crafted by the man who raised her.

results.title: Astrolatry
results.overview: An obsessive loner's infatuation with a beauty cream model propels him into violent delusions after an alien meteor crash-lands onto his rooftop.

results.title: Apocalypse
results.overview: 40 years ago, this pine forest saw the Apocalypse. It resurrected once, but will it be able to resurrect after another Apocalypse?
